metadata.name: Prepare an approved reply on a conversation
metadata.goal: Reopen one conversation and prepare the approved reply in the composer, without sending it.

successCriteria.description: The composer holds the approved reply text for the selected identity and thread.
Nothing was sent: the Journey ends at the filled composer, with no Send click and no submit key press.

parameters.name: commentId
parameters.description: The comment to reply to; its permalink leaf, used in the navigate URL template.

parameters.name: replyIdentity
parameters.description: The reply identity (account) to select as the sender.

parameters.name: expected_commentid
parameters.description: The comment id the reopened page must show, checked before the composer is touched (assertion only).

parameters.name: expected_account
parameters.description: The account the source comment must belong to, checked before the composer is touched (assertion only).

parameters.name: expected_sourcetext
parameters.description: The source comment's full text, checked before the composer is touched (assertion only).

parameters.name: replyText
parameters.description: The approved reply text, typed verbatim into the composer.

boundary.nextStep: Read the prepared reply in Community, then click Send yourself.

recording.intent: Reopen one comment and prepare its approved reply, without sending it.

steps.objective: Reopen exactly the comment's own permalink.
steps.expectedResult: The browser is on the comment's permalink.

steps.objective: Prove the page shows the expected comment before touching the composer.
steps.expectedResult: The source comment carries the expected comment id.

steps.objective: Prove the source comment belongs to the expected account before touching the composer.
steps.expectedResult: The source comment carries the expected account.

steps.objective: Prove the page shows the expected source text before touching the composer.
steps.expectedResult: The source comment contains the expected source text.

steps.objective: Refuse a reply identity other than the account this conversation belongs to, before the composer is touched.
steps.expectedResult: The source comment belongs to the requested reply identity.

steps.objective: Refuse a thread other than the one this conversation is in, before the composer is touched.
steps.expectedResult: The reopened conversation is in the requested thread.

steps.objective: Select the reply identity the approved request names.
steps.expectedResult: The reply-as select holds the requested identity.

steps.objective: Select the thread the approved request names.
steps.expectedResult: The thread select holds the requested thread.

steps.objective: Type the approved reply text into the composer and stop.
steps.expectedResult: The composer holds the approved reply text; nothing is submitted.
